mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sensory endings was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway connected the gland, vessels and nerves to the skin’s functions rather than treating it as just a covering.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first attempt to join epidermis and dermis was confusing: the barrier could not combine with anything until the dermis had vessels, although the two layers seemed ready to join.

surprise.text: I expected the two skin layers to join directly; inspection instead revealed that the dermis first needed blood vessels.

arbitrary.text: The required vessel-first order felt somewhat arbitrary because its necessity was not explained before the failed combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the planned cutaways linked structures to functions, especially barrier renewal and sensory connections, despite the unclear assembly order.
